activity_summary: At home, by candle, the opened letter lay on the desk. The seal was broken. Dust from the road was still on the wrapper. No one else was in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put it where the candle could find the hand.

facets.activity: Left the opened letter on the desk
